independent_observations.layout: Western L-shaped enclosed mixed work/residence connects a north work-bed crossbar and narrow south workstation leg. Its internal ladder opens onto the same L-shaped flat open roof storage terrace; a low timber-framed eastern water court belongs to this single whole body. Ground work/residence plus open roof storage, rather than a separate enclosed upper bedroom, is the relevant complete spatial organization.
independent_observations.proportion: 16x8x16 source envelope; working floor at0/use1 and roof floor5/use6. 841 records=712 nonair+129 explicitair,1207 omitted. Eight source layers are not eight storeys; sparse omitted cells are not cleared air.
independent_observations.facade: Smooth/cut sandstone thick enclosure and spruce timber divide inset openings and low projecting eaves. Ten closed fence-gate states paired at y2/3 are windows/decorative enclosure, not ten court doors or new buildings.
independent_observations.roof: Open flat L-roof supports two upper barrels; closed top ladder trapdoor defines the arrival, with west plank landing. Lit campfire at3,5,4 is an empty original cooking array and roof detail, not evidence of a third floor or working chimney/fire safety.
independent_observations.materials: One smithing table/crafting pair and smoker in northern crossbar, two empty unlit blast furnaces/stonecutter/damaged anvil/wall grindstone in southern leg, one orange bed pair. Fourteen original water states plus two waterlogged stair states do not establish a cooling machine or hydraulic loop; no lava.
independent_observations.circulation: South closed door lower7,1,11/upper7,2,11 leads to explicit inside air7,1/2,10; outside7,1/2,12 is omitted. West-facing ladder8,1..5,10 ends at closed bottom west trapdoor8,6,10 and air8,7,10, beside plank7,5,10/air7,6..7,10. Intent only; real door, trapdoor, headroom and NPC pathfinding untested.
independent_observations.ground_relationship: Low sandstone base surrounds exterior watercourt/pool and timber frame; root is desert biome-tag jigsaw structure size2/max64/start0/surface/beardthin, expansionfalse, single rigid empty-processor/fallback root. No actual terrain support/water sealing/spawn/native placement proof.
